chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Isma'il ibn Marrar, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from more than one person, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:

Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him) stood to deliver a sermon among the Children of Israel and said: O Children of Israel! Do not impart wisdom to the ignorant, for you will have wronged it; and do not withhold it from those worthy of it, for you will have wronged them.

key_terms.أهلها: Its people/those worthy of it — those with the intellectual capacity, spiritual readiness, and sincere intention to receive wisdom
key_terms.الجهال: The ignorant — those lacking the intellectual and spiritual preparation to properly receive and apply wisdom
key_terms.الحكمة: Wisdom — the deep understanding of reality, truth, and appropriate action; not merely factual knowledge but insight guiding right conduct
key_terms.تظلموا: You will have wronged/oppressed — zulm (injustice) committed either against wisdom by degrading it, or against people by depriving them

ai.seo_question: What did Jesus (Isa) say about sharing wisdom with the ignorant?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) relates a teaching of Prophet Isa (Jesus), peace be upon him, delivered as a sermon to the Children of Israel. The sermon addresses the responsibility of those who possess wisdom: it should not be shared indiscriminately with the ignorant — who lack the capacity to receive it properly — nor should it be withheld from those who genuinely deserve and can benefit from it. Both misapplications constitute a form of injustice (zulm), either toward the wisdom itself or toward its rightful inheritors.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Ibrahim b. Hashim from Isma`il b. Marrar from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from another person from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as). He said:

`Isa b. Maryam (as) stood to deliver a sermon to the Children of Israel. So, he said: O Children of Israel! Do not impart wisdom to the ignorant, for you will have oppressed it; and do not prevent it from its people, for you will have oppressed them.
